summary: This bill requires the Assistant Secretary of Commerce for Communications and Information to report to Congress on whether the Departments of the Interior and Agriculture have established online portals for processing Form 299s for communications use authorizations and any barriers to doing so.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to streamline the process for establishing communications facilities by requiring online portals for Form 299 submissions. While it deals with infrastructure for communications, it does not address data protection, privacy regulations, or oversight of tech companies' practices. Its focus is purely on administrative efficiency for infrastructure deployment.
